title: kvxputerzero
summary: kvxputerzero is a port of kvxputer, now on the zero!
description: kvxputer Zero is a port of kvxputer to the M5Stack Cardputer Zero. It brings the same pocket toolkit for wireless research, network analysis and hardware experimentation to M5Stack’s Linux-based keyboard handheld. The Wii-style channel menu, on-device customization (remappable shortcuts, SD themes, boot animations, UI and brightness options, configurable startup app) and the modular tool layout all carry over from the original firmware.
